'''Red County''' is a county in the [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|state of San Andreas]] that appears in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. It is the largest county in the state, being bordered by [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]] to the south and [[Bone County (3D Universe)|Bone County]] and [[Las Venturas]] to the north.

==Description==
The area appears to be based on various mountain areas of Southern California and the Central Valley, and the name may be a reference to Orange County, as both are names of colors. The county contains  four towns: [[Palomino Creek]], [[Montgomery (3D Universe)|Montgomery]], [[Blueberry]] and [[Dillimore]]. Red County is a rural area, containing many hills and forests, and a stream resembling the real-life Kern River flows through it, from Palomino Creek in the east to [[Flint County (3D Universe)|Flint County]] in the west. There are also many farms in Red County, like [[Blueberry Acres]] and the [[Hilltop Farm]].

The county is bordered by Los Santos to the south, Flint County and [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] to the west, and [[Bone County (3D Universe)|Bone County]] and [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]] to the north.

There is also a [[Dillimore Police Station|police station]] in Dillimore, serving as the sole police station in the region of Red County.

==Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''==
{{Spoiler}}
Red County is accessible to the player from the beginning of the game, although the safehouses in this map area cannot be purchased until after the mission [[The Green Sabre]].

After the shootout with the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] at the [[Mulholland Intersection]], [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] is abandoned in the countryside by [[C.R.A.S.H.]] officers [[Frank Tenpenny]] and [[Eddie Pulaski]]. There, CJ starts doing various jobs to earn money, and to try to bail his brother [[Sweet Johnson|Sweet]] out of jail. On the advice of [[Cesar Vialpando]], CJ meets with Cesar's cousin [[Catalina]] in Dillimore. From her [[Catalina's Hideout|hideout]] on [[Fern Ridge]], CJ and Catalina then commit several robberies together in the four towns of Red County: a [[Tanker Commander|gas station]] in Dillimore, a [[Local Liquor Store|liquor store]] in Blueberry, the [[Against All Odds|betting shop]] in Montgomery and [[Small Town Bank|the bank]] in Palomino Creek.

==Trivia==
*[[Las Venturas Police Department]] officers can sometimes been seen in the northern fringes of the county.
*There are some areas that, due to its administrative division by rectangular plots, are dubbed wrongly as part of Red County:
**The highway near [[Martin Bridge]] to [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] and [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|vice versa]].
**After exiting [[Fallow Bridge]].
**Near [[Flint County Road Tunnel]] to [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]] most likely from [[Easter Bay Chemicals]].
**The area near [[Fallen Tree]].
**After exiting [[Frederick Bridge]].
**The shore area near [[Rockshore West]].
*Red County also exists in some form in the [[HD Universe]] since it is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto IV]]'' and the CB radio of semi trucks in ''[[Grand Theft Auto V]]''.
*All safehouses that can be bought in Red County have the exact same interior.
*During the mission [[Small Town Bank]], the police act like Andy Taylor and Barney Fife in ''The Andy Griffith Show'', showing the stereotypical incompetency of rural policemen.
*In the [[Personal Computer|PC]] version of the game, most of the parked vehicles at some locations in Red County do not spawn for unknown reasons, while in the [[PlayStation 2|PS2]] version, they will spawn properly.
